title: AZ-900 · Describe the core architectural components of Azure · Module assessment

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe the core architectural components of Azure
questions.question: Which statement best describes Microsoft Azure?

options.text: An Azure service or resource pinned to a specific availability zone
A service for building, training, and managing custom machine-learning models
A logical container in which every Azure resource belongs to exactly one group at a time
A global cloud platform with services for building, managing, and deploying applications and infrastructure

questions.explanation: Microsoft Azure is a global cloud platform with services for building, managing, and deploying applications and infrastructure.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe the core architectural components of Azure
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Azure virtual machines refer to?

options.text: An Azure compute option for running existing or custom server workloads
The identity relationship used to access Azure and own one or more subscriptions
A Microsoft partner that can sell and manage Azure services for customers
A student offer that provides credit and developer benefits without requiring a credit card for sign-up

questions.explanation: Azure virtual machines is an Azure compute option for running existing or custom server workloads.

questions.question: Which description correctly matches Managed databases?

questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of Azure AI services?

questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Microsoft Azure: prebuilt cloud AI capabilities that can add intelligent features to applications.
Azure virtual machines: the worldwide infrastructure that enables Azure services to be deployed close to users and across regions.
Microsoft Azure: a global cloud platform with services for building, managing, and deploying applications and infrastructure.
Azure virtual machines: an Azure compute option for running existing or custom server workloads.
Managed databases: the identity relationship used to access Azure and own one or more subscriptions.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Microsoft Azure — a global cloud platform with services for building, managing, and deploying applications and infrastructure; and Azure virtual machines — an Azure compute option for running existing or custom server workloads.
